title: Garden after dark
alt: An amber glass sphere and silver botanical engravings in a garden-event poster.
description: Fine botanical engraving, luminous glass and four lines of event typography.
prompt: A sophisticated cultural-event poster combining intricate botanical engraving and luminous glass sculpture. Ferns, white orchids and curling silver stems surround one glowing amber glass sphere on a dark green background. Precise linework, deep layers and radiant yet controlled light; integrate typography into balanced spaces within the foliage, with the title highly legible. The only visible text is exactly: "GARDEN AFTER DARK"; "An evening of light, leaves and music."; "SATURDAY  7 PM"; "BRING YOUR CURIOSITY". Clear elegant typography, natural line breaks, no additional writing or pseudo-letters.
